_comment: Per-user matters file for the Inbox Cleaner (copy to the user's share
folder as matters.json). Seed it from the onboarding questionnaire.
The analyzer matches message SUBJECTS against each matter's keywords
(whole-word, case-insensitive) and claims the whole conversation when
any message matches. Folder defaults to 'Client\Matter'; add a
"folder" key to override. closed=true archives wholesale (no age
floor); closed=false moves only mail older than the user's age line.
Matters earlier in the file win when keywords overlap — put the more
specific matter first. Avoid generic single words as keywords; check
drafted counts in the review workbook before anything is proposed.
For a generic keyword, add participant_domains (client + counterparty
email domains): a subject hit then only counts if the conversation
also involves someone at those domains. Fill from the cohort's Top
Re-run --analyze after editing; draft cohorts regenerate.
